source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Run command: ipmitool chassis power cycle
2. After system is power cycle and boot into OS,
Run command: ipmitool chassis power status, make sure the power status is off

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. All steps reponse are correct.
2. System can power cycle normally.

original_test_intent: Verify one chassis power cycle transitions the SUT through loss and restoration of power and returns it to a healthy OS, but the preserved source also demands a final off status after boot.
original_method: Do not execute the contradictory current version. After engineer correction, use the approved OOB control path for one power cycle with workload drain, bounded OFF-to-ON transition monitoring, boot-health verification and explicit recovery/final-state handling.
manual_activity: Engineer must decide whether OFF is an intermediate phase of the cycle and ON/OS-ready is the final state, or whether the test instead ends OFF; operator then approves the exact target, workload window and recovery path.
required_inputs: Corrected observation timeline and final state
Power-cycle semantics and canonical power-state values
safety_requirements: Do not execute this contradictory source version.
Never use sshpass, plaintext command-line credentials or disabled host verification.
Do not clear logs before preserving diagnostic evidence.
No fixed sleep as the only transition check.
No repeated cycle or alternate power command as recovery.
Require explicit approval and one-attempt limit after correction.
agent_execution_scope: Static analysis and evidence-plan drafting only while blocked.
After separately approved correction, capture baseline and issue exactly one cycle over the verified OOB path.
Poll canonical OFF and ON phases plus console, OS and health readiness within bounded timeouts.
Return raw and normalized evidence without retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve the final-state contradiction and approve the observation timeline.
Approve target, workload drain, timeout, recovery and final state.
Authorize any corrected execution and own PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Must not run: SSH password exposure and host-key bypass are unsafe, the command acts from the DUT rather than a protected OOB control plane, and fixed sleep/status cannot resolve the acceptance conflict.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No executable command until semantic correction; afterward use the approved protected OOB tool with state-machine polling and boot-health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The ipmitool cycle/status wording, boot-into-OS requirement, final-off phrase, Script, Criteria and 5/10-minute values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correct the timeline, then re-review a single interlocked OFF-to-ON cycle and recovery workflow.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact approved SUT/BMC after owner correction.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC/IPMI tool, parser and Script revision after correction.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-approved power-cycle semantics, platform power-state model and Project boot/recovery criteria.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Does not guess whether off is intermediate or final and replaces insecure DUT-hop execution with a protected approved control path.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only status evidence cannot replace the power-cycle function; current functional coverage is zero until correction and execution.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative timeline, target, safety and recovery contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A power cycle can interrupt workloads, corrupt data and leave the platform unavailable.

project_override_considerations: Project may approve Redfish, vendor tooling or another control path only with equivalent cycle and boot coverage; it cannot silently choose a final state or claim the original ipmitool path was validated.
expected_evidence: Engineer correction of OFF/ON timeline and final state
Protected command response and timestamped OFF-to-ON transition
Console, OS and platform-health recovery within approved deadlines
No-retry audit, recovery/final-state evidence and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure says the system completes a power cycle and boots into OS, then requires power status off. Unless OFF is explicitly an intermediate checkpoint, these cannot be one final state.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core acceptance timeline is self-contradictory, so no safe, objective PASS/FAIL rule exists until an engineer resolves it.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects unsafe execution and the claim that operator gating alone makes the contradiction executable.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Confirms its BLOCKED result and strengthens preservation of the Master plus exact cycle timeline requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Overrides PARTIAL because correcting a missing executable token does not define a coherent pass state.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps cycle distinct from reset and simple on/off cases while consistently flagging the shared contradiction.

review_improvement: Prevents an unsafe cycle against an impossible criterion and assigns semantic correction, execution approval and verdict to engineers.
independent_technical_reasoning: A normal power cycle includes an OFF interval and then returns to ON, after which OS boot can occur. The source may intend the OFF observation during the interval, but it places the status check after OS boot. Reordering that checkpoint without owner approval would alter the acceptance contract, so BLOCKED is necessary rather than treating missing Project inputs as the issue.
